tools.name: arxiv_summarizer
tools.description: Fetches and summarizes academic papers using Arxiv API. Takes a research topic or keyword and returns summaries of relevant papers.
tools.output: list of paper summaries with titles, authors, and abstracts

tools.name: semantic_scholar
tools.description: **RESEARCH TOOL** - Searches 200M+ academic papers across ALL disciplines using Semantic Scholar API. Provides citation counts, influential citation metrics, and impact scores.
tools.input: research query or topic (any academic field)
tools.output: list of highly-cited papers with titles, authors, abstracts, citation counts, influence scores, and URLs

tools.name: pubmed_search
tools.description: **BIOMEDICAL RESEARCH TOOL** - Searches 35M+ biomedical and life sciences articles using PubMed/MEDLINE database. Essential for medical, healthcare, and biological research queries.
tools.input: biomedical research query or medical topic
tools.output: list of peer-reviewed articles with titles, authors, journal info, abstracts, and PubMed IDs

tools.name: pdf_parser
tools.description: Extracts full text content from PDF research papers and documents. Useful for analyzing downloaded papers or local research documents.
tools.output: extracted text content with metadata (word count, file size)

tools.name: wikipedia_search
tools.description: Retrieves brief summaries from Wikipedia using the Wikipedia API. Takes a topic name and returns relevant Wikipedia content.
tools.output: Wikipedia page summary and key information

tools.name: news_fetcher
tools.description: Fetches latest news articles using NewsAPI. Takes keywords and returns recent articles with titles, descriptions, and sources.
tools.input: keyword or topic for news search
tools.output: list of recent news articles with metadata

tools.name: sentiment_analyzer
tools.description: Performs sentiment analysis using HuggingFace transformers. Analyzes text to determine positive, negative, or neutral sentiment with confidence scores.

tools.name: data_plotter
tools.description: Creates data visualizations and interactive charts. Takes structured data and generates Chart.js-compatible JSON for inline rendering plus static fallback images.
tools.input: structured data (lists, dictionaries) and chart type specification
tools.output: Chart.js configuration JSON and optional PNG fallback path

tools.name: document_writer
tools.description: Generates professional PDF and HTML reports with formatted text, sections, embedded charts, and citations. Creates executive-grade research reports.
tools.input: JSON structure with content, sections, charts, and formatting instructions

tools.name: qa_engine
tools.description: **PRIMARY TOOL** - Generates comprehensive, detailed answers using OpenRouter LLM API. MUST be used as final step to synthesize information from other tools into a complete answer.
tools.input: question text and optional context (can include outputs from previous tools)
tools.output: comprehensive, detailed answer with explanations and insights

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: **WEB INTELLIGENCE TOOL** - Performs live web searches using DuckDuckGo to find current information, URLs, and real-time data. Essential for queries requiring up-to-date information.
tools.output: list of search results with titles, URLs, and snippets

tools.name: web_scraper
tools.description: **WEB EXTRACTION TOOL** - Extracts clean text content from web pages using trafilatura. Converts web pages into structured, readable text for analysis.
tools.input: URL of the web page to scrape
